description: Header file defining the Schedules class for managing broadcast schedule data, including nested classes Sink and Parser, with methods for scanning, handling tuner notifications, and loading DVB EIT data.

classes.name: Schedules
classes.description: Manages broadcast schedules, handles tuner notifications, and processes DVB EIT sections.

classes.name: Schedules::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to receive tuner events and delegate to parent Schedules.

classes.name: Schedules::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB sections related to EIT, manages filtering of sections, and loads data into parent Schedules.

methods.name: Schedules::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for schedule data.

methods.name: Schedules::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes to manage active scanners.

methods.name: Schedules::Load
methods.description: Loads DVB EIT data into the schedule management system.
